70|/-! ### `0`/`1` as sets -/
    71|
    72|section One
    73|
    74|variable [One α] {s : Set α} {a : α}
    75|
    76|/-- The set `1 : Set α` is defined as `{1}` in locale `Pointwise`. -/
    77|@[to_additive "The set `0 : Set α` is defined as `{0}` in locale `Pointwise`."]
    78|protected def one : One (Set α) :=
    79|  ⟨{1}⟩
    80|
    81|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Set.one Set.zero
    82|
    83|open Pointwise
    84|
    85|-- TODO: This would be a good simp lemma scoped to `Pointwise`, but it seems `@[simp]` can't be
    86|-- scoped
    87|@[to_additive]
    88|theorem singleton_one : ({1} : Set α) = 1 :=
    89|  rfl
    90|
    91|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
    92|theorem mem_one : a ∈ (1 : Set α) ↔ a = 1 :=
    93|  Iff.rfl
    94|
    95|@[to_additive]
    96|theorem one_mem_one : (1 : α) ∈ (1 : Set α) :=
    97|  Eq.refl _
    98|
    99|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   100|theorem one_subset : 1 ⊆ s ↔ (1 : α) ∈ s :=
   101|  singleton_subset_iff
   102|
   103|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   104|theorem one_nonempty : (1 : Set α).Nonempty :=
   105|  ⟨1, rfl⟩
   106|
   107|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   108|theorem image_one {f : α → β} : f '' 1 = {f 1} :=
   109|  image_singleton
   110|
   111|@[to_additive]
   112|theorem subset_one_iff_eq : s ⊆ 1 ↔ s = ∅ ∨ s = 1 :=
   113|  subset_singleton_iff_eq
   114|
   115|@[to_additive]
   116|theorem Nonempty.subset_one_iff (h : s.Nonempty) : s ⊆ 1 ↔ s = 1 :=
   117|  h.subset_singleton_iff
   118|
   119|/-- The singleton operation as a `OneHom`. -/
   120|@[to_additive "The singleton operation as a `ZeroHom`."]
   121|def singletonOneHom : OneHom α (Set α) where
   122|  toFun := singleton; map_one' := singleton_one
   123|
   124|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   125|theorem coe_singletonOneHom : (singletonOneHom : α → Set α) = singleton :=
   126|  rfl
   127|
   128|@[to_additive] lemma image_op_one : (1 : Set α).image op = 1 := image_singleton
   129|
   130|@[to_additive (attr := simp) zero_prod_zero]
   131|lemma one_prod_one [One β] : (1 ×ˢ 1 : Set (α × β)) = 1 := by ext; simp [Prod.ext_iff]
   132|
   133|@[deprecated (since := "2025-03-11")]
   134|alias zero_sum_zero := zero_prod_zero
   135|
   136|end One
   137|
   138|/-! ### Set negation/inversion -/
   139|
   140|
   141|section Inv
   142|
   143|/-- The pointwise inversion of set `s⁻¹` is defined as `{x | x⁻¹ ∈ s}` in locale `Pointwise`. It is
   144|equal to `{x⁻¹ | x ∈ s}`, see `Set.image_inv_eq_inv`. -/
   145|@[to_additive
   146|      "The pointwise negation of set `-s` is defined as `{x | -x ∈ s}` in locale `Pointwise`.
   147|      It is equal to `{-x | x ∈ s}`, see `Set.image_neg_eq_neg`."]
   148|protected def inv [Inv α] : Inv (Set α) :=
   149|  ⟨preimage Inv.inv⟩
   150|
   151|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Set.inv Set.neg
   152|
   153|open Pointwise
   154|
   155|section Inv
   156|
   157|variable {ι : Sort*} [Inv α] {s t : Set α} {a : α}
   158|
   159|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   160|theorem mem_inv : a ∈ s⁻¹ ↔ a⁻¹ ∈ s :=
   161|  Iff.rfl
   162|
   163|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   164|theorem inv_preimage : Inv.inv ⁻¹' s = s⁻¹ :=
   165|  rfl
   166|
   167|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   168|theorem inv_empty : (∅ : Set α)⁻¹ = ∅ :=
   169|  rfl
   170|
   171|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   172|theorem inv_univ : (univ : Set α)⁻¹ = univ :=
   173|  rfl
   174|
   175|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   176|theorem inter_inv : (s ∩ t)⁻¹ = s⁻¹ ∩ t⁻¹ :=
   177|  preimage_inter
   178|
   179|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   180|theorem union_inv : (s ∪ t)⁻¹ = s⁻¹ ∪ t⁻¹ :=
   181|  preimage_union
   182|
   183|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   184|theorem compl_inv : sᶜ⁻¹ = s⁻¹ᶜ :=
   185|  preimage_compl
   186|
   187|@[to_additive (attr := simp) neg_prod]
   188|lemma inv_prod [Inv β] (s : Set α) (t : Set β) : (s ×ˢ t)⁻¹ = s⁻¹ ×ˢ t⁻¹ := rfl
   189|
   190|@[deprecated (since := "2025-03-11")]
   191|alias neg_sum := neg_prod
   192|
   193|end Inv
   194|
   195|section InvolutiveInv
   196|
   197|variable [InvolutiveInv α] {s t : Set α} {a : α}
   198|
   199|@[to_additive]
   200|theorem inv_mem_inv : a⁻¹ ∈ s⁻¹ ↔ a ∈ s := by simp only [mem_inv, inv_inv]
   201|
   202|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   203|theorem nonempty_inv : s⁻¹.Nonempty ↔ s.Nonempty :=
   204|  inv_involutive.surjective.nonempty_preimage
   205|
   206|@[to_additive]
   207|theorem Nonempty.inv (h : s.Nonempty) : s⁻¹.Nonempty :=
   208|  nonempty_inv.2 h
   209|
   210|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   211|theorem image_inv_eq_inv : (·⁻¹) '' s = s⁻¹ :=
   212|  congr_fun (image_eq_preimage_of_inverse inv_involutive.leftInverse inv_involutive.rightInverse) _
   213|
   214|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   215|theorem inv_eq_empty : s⁻¹ = ∅ ↔ s = ∅ := by
   216|  rw [← image_inv_eq_inv, image_eq_empty]
   217|
   218|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   219|instance involutiveInv : InvolutiveInv (Set α) where
   220|  inv := Inv.inv
   221|  inv_inv s := by simp only [← inv_preimage, preimage_preimage, inv_inv, preimage_id']
   222|
   223|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   224|theorem inv_subset_inv : s⁻¹ ⊆ t⁻¹ ↔ s ⊆ t :=
   225|  (Equiv.inv α).surjective.preimage_subset_preimage_iff
   226|
   227|@[to_additive]
   228|theorem inv_subset : s⁻¹ ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ t⁻¹ := by rw [← inv_subset_inv, inv_inv]
   229|
   230|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   231|theorem inv_singleton (a : α) : ({a} : Set α)⁻¹ = {a⁻¹} := by
   232|  rw [← image_inv_eq_inv, image_singleton]
   233|
   234|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   235|theorem inv_insert (a : α) (s : Set α) : (insert a s)⁻¹ = insert a⁻¹ s⁻¹ := by
   236|  rw [insert_eq, union_inv, inv_singleton, insert_eq]
   237|
   238|@[to_additive]
   239|theorem inv_range {ι : Sort*} {f : ι → α} : (range f)⁻¹ = range fun i => (f i)⁻¹ := by
   240|  rw [← image_inv_eq_inv]
   241|  exact (range_comp ..).symm
   242|
   243|open MulOpposite
   244|
   245|@[to_additive]
   246|theorem image_op_inv : op '' s⁻¹ = (op '' s)⁻¹ := by
   247|  simp_rw [← image_inv_eq_inv, Function.Semiconj.set_image op_inv s]
   248|
   249|end InvolutiveInv
   250|
   251|end Inv
   252|
   253|open Pointwise
   254|
   255|/-! ### Set addition/multiplication -/
   256|
   257|
   258|section Mul
   259|
   260|variable {ι : Sort*} {κ : ι → Sort*} [Mul α] {s s₁ s₂ t t₁ t₂ u : Set α} {a b : α}
   261|
   262|/-- The pointwise multiplication of sets `s * t` and `t` is defined as `{x * y | x ∈ s, y ∈ t}` in
   263|locale `Pointwise`. -/
   264|@[to_additive
   265|      "The pointwise addition of sets `s + t` is defined as `{x + y | x ∈ s, y ∈ t}` in locale
   266|      `Pointwise`."]
   267|protected def mul : Mul (Set α) :=
   268|  ⟨image2 (· * ·)⟩
   269|
   270|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Set.mul Set.add
   271|
   272|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   273|theorem image2_mul : image2 (· * ·) s t = s * t :=
   274|  rfl
   275|
   276|@[to_additive]
   277|theorem mem_mul : a ∈ s * t ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ t, x * y = a :=
   278|  Iff.rfl
   279|
   280|@[to_additive]
   281|theorem mul_mem_mul : a ∈ s → b ∈ t → a * b ∈ s * t :=
   282|  mem_image2_of_mem
   283|
   284|@[to_additive add_image_prod]
   285|theorem image_mul_prod : (fun x : α × α => x.fst * x.snd) '' s ×ˢ t = s * t :=
   286|  image_prod _
   287|
   288|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   289|theorem empty_mul : ∅ * s = ∅ :=
   290|  image2_empty_left
   291|
   292|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   293|theorem mul_empty : s * ∅ = ∅ :=
   294|  image2_empty_right
   295|
   296|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   297|theorem mul_eq_empty : s * t = ∅ ↔ s = ∅ ∨ t = ∅ :=
   298|  image2_eq_empty_iff
   299|
   300|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   301|theorem mul_nonempty : (s * t).Nonempty ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ t.Nonempty :=
   302|  image2_nonempty_iff
   303|
   304|@[to_additive]
   305|theorem Nonempty.mul : s.Nonempty → t.Nonempty → (s * t).Nonempty :=
   306|  Nonempty.image2
   307|
   308|@[to_additive]
   309|theorem Nonempty.of_mul_left : (s * t).Nonempty → s.Nonempty :=
   310|  Nonempty.of_image2_left
   311|
   312|@[to_additive]
   313|theorem Nonempty.of_mul_right : (s * t).Nonempty → t.Nonempty :=
   314|  Nonempty.of_image2_right
   315|
   316|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   317|theorem mul_singleton : s * {b} = (· * b) '' s :=
   318|  image2_singleton_right
   319|
   320|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   321|theorem singleton_mul : {a} * t = (a * ·) '' t :=
   322|  image2_singleton_left
   323|
   324|@[to_additive]
   325|theorem singleton_mul_singleton : ({a} : Set α) * {b} = {a * b} :=
   326|  image2_singleton
   327|
   328|@[to_additive (attr := mono, gcongr)]
   329|theorem mul_subset_mul : s₁ ⊆ t₁ → s₂ ⊆ t₂ → s₁ * s₂ ⊆ t₁ * t₂ :=
   330|  image2_subset
   331|
   332|@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
   333|theorem mul_subset_mul_left : t₁ ⊆ t₂ → s * t₁ ⊆ s * t₂ :=
   334|  image2_subset_left
   335|
   336|@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
   337|theorem mul_subset_mul_right : s₁ ⊆ s₂ → s₁ * t ⊆ s₂ * t :=
   338|  image2_subset_right
   339|
   340|@[to_additive] instance : MulLeftMono (Set α) where elim _s _t₁ _t₂ := mul_subset_mul_left
   341|@[to_additive] instance : MulRightMono (Set α) where elim _t _s₁ _s₂ := mul_subset_mul_right
   342|
   343|@[to_additive]
   344|theorem mul_subset_iff : s * t ⊆ u ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x * y ∈ u :=
   345|  image2_subset_iff
   346|
   347|@[to_additive]
   348|theorem union_mul : (s₁ ∪ s₂) * t = s₁ * t ∪ s₂ * t :=
   349|  image2_union_left
   350|
   351|@[to_additive]
   352|theorem mul_union : s * (t₁ ∪ t₂) = s * t₁ ∪ s * t₂ :=
   353|  image2_union_right
   354|
   355|@[to_additive]
   356|theorem inter_mul_subset : s₁ ∩ s₂ * t ⊆ s₁ * t ∩ (s₂ * t) :=
   357|  image2_inter_subset_left
   358|
   359|@[to_additive]
   360|theorem mul_inter_subset : s * (t₁ ∩ t₂) ⊆ s * t₁ ∩ (s * t₂) :=
   361|  image2_inter_subset_right
   362|
   363|@[to_additive]
   364|theorem inter_mul_union_subset_union : s₁ ∩ s₂ * (t₁ ∪ t₂) ⊆ s₁ * t₁ ∪ s₂ * t₂ :=
   365|  image2_inter_union_subset_union
   366|
   367|@[to_additive]
   368|theorem union_mul_inter_subset_union : (s₁ ∪ s₂) * (t₁ ∩ t₂) ⊆ s₁ * t₁ ∪ s₂ * t₂ :=
   369|  image2_union_inter_subset_union
   370|
   371|/-- The singleton operation as a `MulHom`. -/
   372|@[to_additive "The singleton operation as an `AddHom`."]
   373|def singletonMulHom : α →ₙ* Set α where
   374|  toFun := singleton
   375|  map_mul' _ _ := singleton_mul_singleton.symm
   376|
   377|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   378|theorem coe_singletonMulHom : (singletonMulHom : α → Set α) = singleton :=
   379|  rfl
   380|
   381|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   382|theorem singletonMulHom_apply (a : α) : singletonMulHom a = {a} :=
   383|  rfl
   384|
   385|open MulOpposite
   386|
   387|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   388|theorem image_op_mul : op '' (s * t) = op '' t * op '' s :=
   389|  image_image2_antidistrib op_mul
   390|
   391|@[to_additive (attr := simp) prod_add_prod_comm]
   392|lemma prod_mul_prod_comm [Mul β] (s₁ s₂ : Set α) (t₁ t₂ : Set β) :
   393|   (s₁ ×ˢ t₁) * (s₂ ×ˢ t₂) = (s₁ * s₂) ×ˢ (t₁ * t₂) := by ext; simp [mem_mul]; aesop
   394|
   395|@[deprecated (since := "2025-03-11")]
   396|alias sum_add_sum_comm := prod_add_prod_comm
   397|
   398|end Mul
   399|
   400|/-! ### Set subtraction/division -/
   401|
   402|
   403|section Div
   404|
   405|variable {ι : Sort*} {κ : ι → Sort*} [Div α] {s s₁ s₂ t t₁ t₂ u : Set α} {a b : α}
   406|
   407|/-- The pointwise division of sets `s / t` is defined as `{x / y | x ∈ s, y ∈ t}` in locale
   408|`Pointwise`. -/
   409|@[to_additive
   410|      "The pointwise subtraction of sets `s - t` is defined as `{x - y | x ∈ s, y ∈ t}` in locale
   411|      `Pointwise`."]
   412|protected def div : Div (Set α) :=
   413|  ⟨image2 (· / ·)⟩
   414|
   415|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Set.div Set.sub
   416|
   417|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   418|theorem image2_div : image2 (· / ·) s t = s / t :=
   419|  rfl
   420|
   421|@[to_additive]
   422|theorem mem_div : a ∈ s / t ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ t, x / y = a :=
   423|  Iff.rfl
   424|
   425|@[to_additive]
   426|theorem div_mem_div : a ∈ s → b ∈ t → a / b ∈ s / t :=
   427|  mem_image2_of_mem
   428|
   429|@[to_additive sub_image_prod]
   430|theorem image_div_prod : (fun x : α × α => x.fst / x.snd) '' s ×ˢ t = s / t :=
   431|  image_prod _
   432|
   433|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   434|theorem empty_div : ∅ / s = ∅ :=
   435|  image2_empty_left
   436|
   437|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   438|theorem div_empty : s / ∅ = ∅ :=
   439|  image2_empty_right
   440|
   441|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   442|theorem div_eq_empty : s / t = ∅ ↔ s = ∅ ∨ t = ∅ :=
   443|  image2_eq_empty_iff
   444|
   445|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   446|theorem div_nonempty : (s / t).Nonempty ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ t.Nonempty :=
   447|  image2_nonempty_iff
   448|
   449|@[to_additive]
   450|theorem Nonempty.div : s.Nonempty → t.Nonempty → (s / t).Nonempty :=
   451|  Nonempty.image2
   452|
   453|@[to_additive]
   454|theorem Nonempty.of_div_left : (s / t).Nonempty → s.Nonempty :=
   455|  Nonempty.of_image2_left
   456|
   457|@[to_additive]
   458|theorem Nonempty.of_div_right : (s / t).Nonempty → t.Nonempty :=
   459|  Nonempty.of_image2_right
   460|
   461|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   462|theorem div_singleton : s / {b} = (· / b) '' s :=
   463|  image2_singleton_right
   464|
   465|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   466|theorem singleton_div : {a} / t = (· / ·) a '' t :=
   467|  image2_singleton_left
   468|
   469|@[to_additive]
   470|theorem singleton_div_singleton : ({a} : Set α) / {b} = {a / b} :=
   471|  image2_singleton
   472|
   473|@[to_additive (attr := mono, gcongr)]
   474|theorem div_subset_div : s₁ ⊆ t₁ → s₂ ⊆ t₂ → s₁ / s₂ ⊆ t₁ / t₂ :=
   475|  image2_subset
   476|
   477|@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
   478|theorem div_subset_div_left : t₁ ⊆ t₂ → s / t₁ ⊆ s / t₂ :=
   479|  image2_subset_left
   480|
   481|@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
   482|theorem div_subset_div_right : s₁ ⊆ s₂ → s₁ / t ⊆ s₂ / t :=
   483|  image2_subset_right
   484|
   485|@[to_additive]
   486|theorem div_subset_iff : s / t ⊆ u ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x / y ∈ u :=
   487|  image2_subset_iff
   488|
   489|@[to_additive]
   490|theorem union_div : (s₁ ∪ s₂) / t = s₁ / t ∪ s₂ / t :=
   491|  image2_union_left
   492|
   493|@[to_additive]
   494|theorem div_union : s / (t₁ ∪ t₂) = s / t₁ ∪ s / t₂ :=
   495|  image2_union_right
   496|
   497|@[to_additive]
   498|theorem inter_div_subset : s₁ ∩ s₂ / t ⊆ s₁ / t ∩ (s₂ / t) :=
   499|  image2_inter_subset_left
   500|
   501|@[to_additive]
   502|theorem div_inter_subset : s / (t₁ ∩ t₂) ⊆ s / t₁ ∩ (s / t₂) :=
   503|  image2_inter_subset_right
   504|
   505|@[to_additive]
   506|theorem inter_div_union_subset_union : s₁ ∩ s₂ / (t₁ ∪ t₂) ⊆ s₁ / t₁ ∪ s₂ / t₂ :=
   507|  image2_inter_union_subset_union
   508|
   509|@[to_additive]
   510|theorem union_div_inter_subset_union : (s₁ ∪ s₂) / (t₁ ∩ t₂) ⊆ s₁ / t₁ ∪ s₂ / t₂ :=
   511|  image2_union_inter_subset_union
   512|
   513|end Div
   514|
   515|/-- Repeated pointwise addition (not the same as pointwise repeated addition!) of a `Set`. See
   516|note [pointwise nat action]. -/
   517|protected def NSMul [Zero α] [Add α] : SMul ℕ (Set α) :=
   518|  ⟨nsmulRec⟩
   519|
   520|/-- Repeated pointwise multiplication (not the same as pointwise repeated multiplication!) of a
   521|`Set`. See note [pointwise nat action]. -/
   522|@[to_additive existing]
   523|protected def NPow [One α] [Mul α] : Pow (Set α) ℕ :=
   524|  ⟨fun s n => npowRec n s⟩
   525|
   526|/-- Repeated pointwise addition/subtraction (not the same as pointwise repeated
   527|addition/subtraction!) of a `Set`. See note [pointwise nat action]. -/
   528|protected def ZSMul [Zero α] [Add α] [Neg α] : SMul ℤ (Set α) :=
   529|  ⟨zsmulRec⟩
   530|
   531|/-- Repeated pointwise multiplication/division (not the same as pointwise repeated
   532|multiplication/division!) of a `Set`. See note [pointwise nat action]. -/
   533|@[to_additive existing]
   534|protected def ZPow [One α] [Mul α] [Inv α] : Pow (Set α) ℤ :=
   535|  ⟨fun s n => zpowRec npowRec n s⟩
   536|
   537|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Set.NSMul Set.NPow Set.ZSMul Set.ZPow
   538|
   539|/-- `Set α` is a `Semigroup` under pointwise operations if `α` is. -/
   540|@[to_additive "`Set α` is an `AddSemigroup` under pointwise operations if `α` is."]
   541|protected def semigroup [Semigroup α] : Semigroup (Set α) :=
   542|  { Set.mul with mul_assoc := fun _ _ _ => image2_assoc mul_assoc }
   543|
   544|section CommSemigroup
   545|
   546|variable [CommSemigroup α] {s t : Set α}
   547|
   548|/-- `Set α` is a `CommSemigroup` under pointwise operations if `α` is. -/
   549|@[to_additive "`Set α` is an `AddCommSemigroup` under pointwise operations if `α` is."]
   550|protected def commSemigroup : CommSemigroup (Set α) :=
   551|  { Set.semigroup with mul_comm := fun _ _ => image2_comm mul_comm }
   552|
   553|@[to_additive]
   554|theorem inter_mul_union_subset : s ∩ t * (s ∪ t) ⊆ s * t :=
   555|  image2_inter_union_subset mul_comm
   556|
   557|@[to_additive]
   558|theorem union_mul_inter_subset : (s ∪ t) * (s ∩ t) ⊆ s * t :=
   559|  image2_union_inter_subset mul_comm
   560|
   561|end CommSemigroup
   562|
   563|section MulOneClass
   564|
   565|variable [MulOneClass α]
   566|
   567|/-- `Set α` is a `MulOneClass` under pointwise operations if `α` is. -/

   606|/-- `Set α` is a `Monoid` under pointwise operations if `α` is. -/
   607|@[to_additive "`Set α` is an `AddMonoid` under pointwise operations if `α` is."]
   608|protected def monoid : Monoid (Set α) :=

   611|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Set.monoid Set.addMonoid
   612|
   613|-- `Set.pow_left_monotone` doesn't exist since it would syntactically be a special case of
   614|-- `pow_left_mono`
   615|
   616|@[to_additive]
   617|protected lemma pow_right_monotone (hs : 1 ∈ s) : Monotone (s ^ ·) :=
   618|  pow_right_monotone <| one_subset.2 hs
   619|
   620|@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
   621|lemma pow_subset_pow_left (hst : s ⊆ t) : s ^ n ⊆ t ^ n := pow_left_mono _ hst
   622|
   623|@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
   624|lemma pow_subset_pow_right (hs : 1 ∈ s) (hmn : m ≤ n) : s ^ m ⊆ s ^ n :=
   625|  Set.pow_right_monotone hs hmn
   626|
   627|@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
   628|lemma pow_subset_pow (hst : s ⊆ t) (ht : 1 ∈ t) (hmn : m ≤ n) : s ^ m ⊆ t ^ n :=
   629|  (pow_subset_pow_left hst).trans (pow_subset_pow_right ht hmn)
   630|
   631|@[to_additive]
   632|lemma subset_pow (hs : 1 ∈ s) (hn : n ≠ 0) : s ⊆ s ^ n := by
   633|  simpa using pow_subset_pow_right hs <| Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hn
   634|
   635|@[deprecated (since := "2024-11-19")] alias pow_subset_pow_of_one_mem := pow_subset_pow_right
   636|
   637|@[deprecated (since := "2024-11-19")]
   638|alias nsmul_subset_nsmul_of_zero_mem := nsmul_subset_nsmul_right
   639|
   640|@[to_additive]
   641|lemma pow_subset_pow_mul_of_sq_subset_mul (hst : s ^ 2 ⊆ t * s) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
   642|    s ^ n ⊆ t ^ (n - 1) * s := pow_le_pow_mul_of_sq_le_mul hst hn
   643|
   644|@[to_additive (attr := simp) nsmul_empty]
   645|lemma empty_pow (hn : n ≠ 0) : (∅ : Set α) ^ n = ∅ := match n with | n + 1 => by simp [pow_succ]
   646|
   647|@[to_additive]
   648|lemma Nonempty.pow (hs : s.Nonempty) : ∀ {n}, (s ^ n).Nonempty
   649|  | 0 => by simp
   650|  | n + 1 => by rw [pow_succ]; exact hs.pow.mul hs
   651|
   652|set_option push_neg.use_distrib true in
   653|@[to_additive (attr := simp)] lemma pow_eq_empty : s ^ n = ∅ ↔ s = ∅ ∧ n ≠ 0 := by
   654|  constructor
   655|  · contrapose!
   656|    rintro (hs | rfl)
   657|    · exact hs.pow
   658|    · simp
   659|  · rintro ⟨rfl, hn⟩
   660|    exact empty_pow hn
   661|
   662|@[to_additive (attr := simp) nsmul_singleton]
   663|lemma singleton_pow (a : α) : ∀ n, ({a} : Set α) ^ n = {a ^ n}
   664|  | 0 => by simp [singleton_one]
   665|  | n + 1 => by simp [pow_succ, singleton_pow _ n]
   666|
   667|@[to_additive] lemma pow_mem_pow (ha : a ∈ s) : a ^ n ∈ s ^ n := by
   668|  simpa using pow_subset_pow_left (singleton_subset_iff.2 ha)
   669|
   670|@[to_additive] lemma one_mem_pow (hs : 1 ∈ s) : 1 ∈ s ^ n := by simpa using pow_mem_pow hs
   671|
   672|@[to_additive]
   673|lemma inter_pow_subset : (s ∩ t) ^ n ⊆ s ^ n ∩ t ^ n := by apply subset_inter <;> gcongr <;> simp
   674|
   675|@[to_additive]
   676|theorem mul_univ_of_one_mem (hs : (1 : α) ∈ s) : s * univ = univ :=
   677|  eq_univ_iff_forall.2 fun _ => mem_mul.2 ⟨_, hs, _, mem_univ _, one_mul _⟩
   678|
   679|@[to_additive]
   680|theorem univ_mul_of_one_mem (ht : (1 : α) ∈ t) : univ * t = univ :=
   681|  eq_univ_iff_forall.2 fun _ => mem_mul.2 ⟨_, mem_univ _, _, ht, mul_one _⟩
   682|
   683|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   684|theorem univ_mul_univ : (univ : Set α) * univ = univ :=
   685|  mul_univ_of_one_mem <| mem_univ _
   686|
   687|@[to_additive (attr := simp) nsmul_univ]
   688|theorem univ_pow : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → (univ : Set α) ^ n = univ
   689|  | 0 => fun h => (h rfl).elim
   690|  | 1 => fun _ => pow_one _
   691|  | n + 2 => fun _ => by rw [pow_succ, univ_pow n.succ_ne_zero, univ_mul_univ]
   692|
   693|@[to_additive]
   694|protected theorem _root_.IsUnit.set : IsUnit a → IsUnit ({a} : Set α) :=
   695|  IsUnit.map (singletonMonoidHom : α →* Set α)
   696|
   697|@[to_additive nsmul_prod]
   698|lemma prod_pow [Monoid β] (s : Set α) (t : Set β) : ∀ n, (s ×ˢ t) ^ n = (s ^ n) ×ˢ (t ^ n)
   699|  | 0 => by simp
   700|  | n + 1 => by simp [pow_succ, prod_pow _ _ n]
   701|
   702|@[deprecated (since := "2025-02-17")] alias sum_nsmul := nsmul_prod
   703|
   704|end Monoid

   749|section DivisionMonoid

   751|variable [DivisionMonoid α] {s t : Set α} {n : ℤ}
   752|
   753|@[to_additive]
   754|protected theorem mul_eq_one_iff : s * t = 1 ↔ ∃ a b, s = {a} ∧ t = {b} ∧ a * b = 1 := by
   755|  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
   756|  · have hst : (s * t).Nonempty := h.symm.subst one_nonempty
   757|    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hst.of_image2_left
   758|    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hst.of_image2_right
   759|    have H : ∀ {a b}, a ∈ s → b ∈ t → a * b = (1 : α) := fun {a b} ha hb =>
   760|      h.subset <| mem_image2_of_mem ha hb
   761|    refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_, H ha hb⟩ <;> refine eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2 ⟨‹_›, fun x hx => ?_⟩
   762|    · exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left <| H hx hb).trans (inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left <| H ha hb)
   763|    · exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right <| H ha hx).trans (inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right <| H ha hb)
   764|  · rintro ⟨b, c, rfl, rfl, h⟩
   765|    rw [singleton_mul_singleton, h, singleton_one]
   766|
   767|/-- `Set α` is a division monoid under pointwise operations if `α` is. -/
   768|@[to_additive
   769|    "`Set α` is a subtraction monoid under pointwise operations if `α` is."]
   770|protected def divisionMonoid : DivisionMonoid (Set α) :=
   771|  { Set.monoid, Set.involutiveInv, Set.div, @Set.ZPow α _ _ _ with
   772|    mul_inv_rev := fun s t => by
   773|      simp_rw [← image_inv_eq_inv]
   774|      exact image_image2_antidistrib mul_inv_rev
   775|    inv_eq_of_mul := fun s t h => by
   776|      obtain ⟨a, b, rfl, rfl, hab⟩ := Set.mul_eq_one_iff.1 h
   777|      rw [inv_singleton, inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right hab]
   778|    div_eq_mul_inv := fun s t => by
   779|      rw [← image_id (s / t), ← image_inv_eq_inv]
   780|      exact image_image2_distrib_right div_eq_mul_inv }
   781|
   782|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Set.divisionMonoid Set.subtractionMonoid
   783|
   784|@[to_additive (attr := simp 500)]
   785|theorem isUnit_iff : IsUnit s ↔ ∃ a, s = {a} ∧ IsUnit a := by
   786|  constructor
   787|  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
   788|    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, h⟩ := Set.mul_eq_one_iff.1 u.mul_inv
   789|    refine ⟨a, ha, ⟨a, b, h, singleton_injective ?_⟩, rfl⟩
   790|    rw [← singleton_mul_singleton, ← ha, ← hb]
   791|    exact u.inv_mul
   792|  · rintro ⟨a, rfl, ha⟩
   793|    exact ha.set
   794|
   795|@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
   796|lemma univ_div_univ : (univ / univ : Set α) = univ := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
   797|
   798|@[to_additive] lemma subset_div_left (ht : 1 ∈ t) : s ⊆ s / t := by
   799|  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; exact subset_mul_left _ <| by simpa
   800|
   801|@[to_additive] lemma inv_subset_div_right (hs : 1 ∈ s) : t⁻¹ ⊆ s / t := by
   802|  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; exact subset_mul_right _ hs
   803|
   804|@[to_additive (attr := simp) zsmul_empty]
   805|lemma empty_zpow (hn : n ≠ 0) : (∅ : Set α) ^ n = ∅ := by cases n <;> aesop
   806|
   807|@[to_additive]
   808|lemma Nonempty.zpow (hs : s.Nonempty) : ∀ {n : ℤ}, (s ^ n).Nonempty
   809|  | (n : ℕ) => hs.pow
   810|  | .negSucc n => by simpa using hs.pow
   811|
   812|set_option push_neg.use_distrib true in
   813|@[to_additive (attr := simp)] lemma zpow_eq_empty : s ^ n = ∅ ↔ s = ∅ ∧ n ≠ 0 := by
   814|  constructor
   815|  · contrapose!
   816|    rintro (hs | rfl)
   817|    · exact hs.zpow
   818|    · simp
   819|  · rintro ⟨rfl, hn⟩
   820|    exact empty_zpow hn
   821|
   822|@[to_additive (attr := simp) zsmul_singleton]
   823|lemma singleton_zpow (a : α) (n : ℤ) : ({a} : Set α) ^ n = {a ^ n} := by cases n <;> simp
